reason: I have a crew problem already, and this offer leaves the two things I care about blank: how the crews are checked, and what happens if one walks off mid-job. I can get three quotes myself in a week, so I would not hand the job to an unverified crew on a pilot that is not even open yet.
objection: Who checks these crews, and who makes sure the flat gets finished if a crew stops halfway? Right now that is not written down anywhere I can see.
would_change_my_mind: A written verification standard for the crews, a clear stop-mid-job plan, and a few past Tbilisi clients I can call who were happy with the work and the schedule.
